description: This Java class, org.openmrs.util.Security, handles password hashing, encryption, decryption, and related security utilities for the OpenMRS project. It includes methods for hashing strings with SHA-512 and SHA-1, comparing hashed passwords, generating secure tokens, and encrypting/decrypting text using AES encryption.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: A utility class that provides security-related functions such as password hashing, encryption, decryption, and token generation for OpenMRS.

methods.name: hashMatches
methods.description: Compares a stored hashed password with a given plaintext password by checking against multiple hashing algorithms.

methods.name: encodeString
methods.description: Hashes a string using the preferred SHA-512 algorithm and returns a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: encodeStringSHA1
methods.description: Hashes a string using the SHA-1 algorithm.

methods.name: getRandomToken
methods.description: Generates a secure random token encoded as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string using AES encryption with provided initialization vector and secret key.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a string encrypted with AES using specified initialization vector and secret key.

methods.name: getSavedInitVector
methods.description: Retrieves the stored initialization vector from runtime properties.

methods.name: generateNewInitVector
methods.description: Generates a new random initialization vector for encryption.

methods.name: getSavedSecretKey
methods.description: Retrieves the stored secret encryption key from runtime properties.

methods.name: generateNewSecretKey
methods.description: Generates a new AES secret key.
